blocks.text: 25 questions: five from each of the 5 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 85% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for The Prepositional Case. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

exercises.prompt: We work in a factory.
That book is not available for purchase.
Can you water ski?
They're on pins and needles.
She was in the eighth grade.
He was covered with bruises.
Tom is fishing now.
Your account is empty.

exercises.q: Том любит отдохнуть на ___ (кушетка) после долгого дня.
exercises.prompt: Tom likes to rest on the couch after a long day.
Good luck with the new job.
How do you loosen the straps on a backpack?
The cat slept on the windowsill.

exercises.q: Экономика нашей страны находится в ___ (удручающее состояние).
exercises.prompt: The economy of our country is in a depressing state.
Tom got caught taking a bribe.
That was just icing on the cake.
I wound up in the hospital.

exercises.q: Мне нужно больше жира в ___ (мой рацион).
exercises.prompt: I need more grease in my diet.
Nobody equals him in strength.

exercises.q: Том зашёл в комнату в ___ (купальный халат).
exercises.prompt: Tom came into the room wearing a bathrobe.

exercises.q: Если я и пробегу марафон, на ___ (финиш) я упаду замертво.
exercises.prompt: If I were to run a marathon, I'd drop dead at the finish line.
You're in fine shape.
Tom is proficient in French.
It's on its last legs.
Tom plays the xylophone.

exercises.q: Мне дают дополнительное время на ___ (экзамены), потому что я дислексик.
exercises.prompt: I get extra time on exams because I'm dyslexic.

exercises.q: Георгий - самый прилежный мальчик в ___ (наш класс).
exercises.prompt: George is the most diligent boy in our class.
There is no equality in nature.

exercises.q: Том и Мэри одни в ___ (подсобное помещение).
exercises.prompt: Tom and Mary are alone in the back room.

exercises.q: На ___ (горизонт) в море садится багровое солнце.
exercises.prompt: On the horizon, the crimson sun is sinking into the sea.
Our prestige is at stake.
I know nothing about robotics.

exercises.q: Фильм повествует о ___ (трагическая судьба) рабов в восемнадцатом веке.
exercises.prompt: The film relates the tragic fate of the slaves in the eighteenth century.

exercises.q: «Вы, наверное, никогда не слышали о ___ (профессор) Мориарти?» — спросил он. — «Никогда».
exercises.prompt: "You have probably never heard of Professor Moriarty?" said he. "Never."

exercises.q: Древние люди любили слагать истории о ___ (храбрость).
exercises.prompt: Ancient people liked to tell stories of bravery.
Did Tom say anything about the shooting?
Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.

exercises.q: Джон, возможно, что-то знает о ___ (мистер) Блэке.
exercises.prompt: John might know something about Mr Black.

exercises.q: О ___ (степень) цивилизованности общества можно судить, попав в его тюрьмы.
exercises.prompt: The degree of civilization in a society can be judged by entering its prisons.
I think about suicide.

exercises.q: Я перерабатываю отходы и забочусь об ___ (окружающая среда).
exercises.prompt: I recycle and take care of the environment.

exercises.q: Позвольте мне рассказать вам о ___ (возникновение) этой школы.
exercises.prompt: Let me tell you about the origin of this school.
The lecturer spoke on pollution problems.

exercises.q: Многие покупают лотерейные билеты, мечтая о ___ (мгновенное обогащение).
exercises.prompt: Many people buy lottery tickets with the dream of immediately becoming wealthy.
I forgot our anniversary.

exercises.q: Я сообщил в полицию об ___ (угон) моей машины.
exercises.prompt: I reported the theft of my car to the police.
Is he aware of the difficulty?
What do you know about pandas?

exercises.q: Том и Мария объявили о ___ (расторжение) своего брака.
exercises.prompt: Tom and Mary announced the dissolution of their marriage.

exercises.q: Несколько садовников заботится об ___ (азалии) в парке.
exercises.prompt: Several gardeners look after the azaleas in the park.
Fabre wrote books about insects.
I plead not guilty.

exercises.q: Я задал ему много вопросов об ___ (экология).
exercises.prompt: I asked him many questions about ecology.

exercises.q: Я не имею никакого понятия о ___ (судебная процедура).
exercises.prompt: I have no acquaintance with court procedure.

exercises.q: Речь идёт о ___ (последний фильм) Андрея Тарковского.
exercises.prompt: It's about the last film of Andrei Tarkovsky.
Mary found out about Tom's secret relationship.
They are debating whether to close the school.

exercises.q: В его голове была гремучая смесь, состоявшая из комплекса неполноценности и мечты о ___ (всемогущество).
exercises.prompt: There was an explosive mixture in his head containing feelings of inferiority as well as visions of omnipotence.
The book was about quantum physics.
I begged Tom for mercy.
We argued politics.

exercises.q: Будет ему сидеть у тестя на ___ (цепь).
